FOUNDER DIRECTIVE (Samuel, 2026-09-08 build-blitz), relayed verbatim in intent by Fable to A, copied to B. Fable adds no authorization of its own. Full brief: C:\Users\sboad\Downloads\XENIOS_BUILD_BLITZ_EXECUTION.txt; source package: XENIOS_IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE_20260908.zip (authored against 0e299d3f; compatibility reference, NOT a reset target).

MISSION (unchanged, expanded): finish the whole agreed Xenios Health platform through tested integration, qualified deployment, activation and verified live journeys — customers, affiliates + referral sharing (dashboard QR/PNG), operational CRM, recruiter/sales, organizations, resources, real purchasing, order visibility, fulfillment, support. Resource Hub is one milestone, not the whole mission. After each qualified release, take the next ready requirement.

A (integration owner + sole production executor): finish the current ready Resource Hub release; own shared backend integration, schema sequencing, and the durable purchasing path (concrete production transaction + provider adapters are NOT in the package — implement them; do not just enable Stripe or force a test-only durable flag). Run the supplied read-only DB preflight for the two candidate SQL files (supabase/candidates/20260908230000_research_crm_workspace.sql, 20260908231000_research_organization_management.sql) on staging tetynodzrtmdbuzgboro, reconcile, rehearse the exact reviewed migrations; never replay an applied migration or apply an unrelated bundle.

B (builder + independent reviewer where eligible): close any genuinely outstanding review, then build dashboard QR/PNG, then CRM and organization interfaces on DISJOINT assigned paths. Not permanent standby; not self-review of your own authored code.

Package integration: from the extracted root, `node tools/integrate.cjs --repo "<isolated worktree>" --slice qr` is a DRY RUN; review file identities/anchors/ownership, then --apply. A mismatch means reconcile the seam, never force-overwrite. Wire canonical navigation; decode the actual downloaded PNG to the exact referral destination; use the canonical referral API, not the offline preview adapter.

Boundaries (verbatim): A pins each production commit + manifest; supported commit-pinned deploy, pre/postchecks, smoke, observation, compatible recovery; preserve records/private objects/migration history/audits; keep application commits separate from evidence-only successors; one writer per path, one heavy suite per shared host; no test removal, weakened authorization, loosened scanners, fabricated evidence or blanket exceptions to hit a deadline; no invented supplier approval, prices, contracts, payment readiness, prescriptions, clinician decisions, compensation or tracking events; preserve Research/Care boundaries. Apply the authentic standing authorization only within its actual scope; if a materially new cost/recipient/grant/price/effect is unapproved, ask once with the exact decision. Installed-with-flags-off is intermediate, not complete.

FABLE STATUS (so you don't duplicate): I am NOT integrating the ZIP or touching backend gaps — those are yours. I am finishing the independent exact-source/evidence review of the current Resource Hub candidate 8be5d582, which is that release's first pending gate. Preliminary verdict + one escalation follow in my next message and on claude/xenios-health-rc-20260908. Do not wait on me for the CRM/org/purchasing build.
